8.3.7.11 Dem_SetDataOfPID4D
[SWS_Dem_00737] Definition of API function Dem_SetDataOfPID4D ⌈
Service Name
Dem_SetDataOfPID4D
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_SetDataOfPID4D (
const uint8* PID4Dvalue
)
Service ID [hex]
0xa8
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
PID4Dvalue
Buffer containing the contents of PID $4D. The buffer is provided
by the Dcm with the appropriate size, i.e. during configuration, the
Dcm identifies the required size from the largest PID in order to
configure a PIDBuffer.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
Always E_OK is returned, as E_NOT_OK will never appear.
Description
Service to set the value of PID $4D in the Dem by a software component. API is needed in
OBD-relevant ECUs only.
API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemGeneral.DemOBDSupport)}
!= DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT)
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
